name: Topological and conformal field theory as axioms (Atiyah, Segal, Witten)
summary: Quantum field theory is recast as a functor from cobordisms to vector spaces, linking invariants of manifolds with physical models.

name: Higgs bundles and the Hitchin system
from: algebraic geometry of moduli of bundles
summary: Self-duality equations on a Riemann surface give an integrable system on the moduli of bundles, linking gauge theory and algebraic geometry.

name: Euler characteristic of Out(F_n) from Feynman-diagram counting
to: cohomology of moduli spaces of graphs
summary: Counting graphs weighted by symmetry was treated as a toy quantum field theory computation, showing the Euler characteristic of moduli spaces of graphs becomes hugely negative and hence that many cohomology classes exist.

name: Floer homology
summary: Infinite-dimensional Morse theory proved Arnold's conjecture.

name: Gromov-Witten / quantum cohomology
summary: Physical topological sigma models gave counts of curves; Ruan-Tian and Kontsevich-Manin made them rigorous.

name: Mirror symmetry
summary: A duality between Calabi-Yau manifolds from string theory predicts numbers of rational curves, later proved mathematically and recast as an equivalence of categories.

name: Blum-Shub-Smale real computation
summary: A machine model over the reals combined Turing computability with numerical analysis.

name: Two-dimensional gravity and the moduli space of curves
summary: A prediction of topological gravity about intersection numbers on moduli spaces of curves is proved by combinatorial (ribbon graph) and hyperbolic-geometric routes.

name: Topological data analysis
summary: Persistent homology gave a computable, stable topological summary of point clouds, with a structure theorem from commutative algebra.

name: Vassiliev invariants
summary: Knot invariants were filtered by order via singular knots, unifying Jones-type polynomials into a finite-type theory.
